structured_output.what_is_happening: About 10 tokens named "affective autism" (a/aut) launched within about 3 minutes of each other around 02:20 UTC. They reference Elon Musk's old X post "Affective autism > effective altruism?" (status 1680821019152379904, from roughly July 2023). The simultaneous launches suggest something re-surfaced the phrase just now, maybe a new Musk post or reply, but I could not confirm that. This token (56aJ…) was launched by a mass-deploy creator with 18,751 launched tokens, using a "Fees to @elonmusk via UsePaid" template. It pumped to about $36.6k market cap at detection, and by T2 it had already fallen to about $22k (−40%). A same-name competitor (FgiV…) has more volume (about $242k in the last hour) and more liquidity.
